ground_truth_reference_answer: Real Property Tax in Davao City consists of two statutory components under Ordinance No. 0291-17: 1) Section 7 imposes the Basic Real Property Tax as an annual ad valorem levy of one and one-half percent (1.5%) of the assessed value of real property (land, buildings, and machinery); and 2) Section 8 imposes an Additional Levy for the Special Education Fund (SEF) of one percent (1%) of the assessed value. The total annual levy is 2.5% of assessed property valuation.
